title: Astro Portal session event payload: pause
description: Marks the session as paused (meridian flip, break, waiting out a cloud). An empty payload is valid on purpose: the pause button is a single one-handed tap. `cause` is an optional entry from a short closed list, so the time a night lost can later be counted by cause; a cause chosen after the tap (during the pause, or later) is not an edit of this event but a `note` carrying `pauseCause` (note.schema.json). `reason` stays the free-text afterthought it always was. See session-events.md for what this type is for and what it deliberately is not.

cause.description: Optional, and closed: clouds, wind, dew — the sky; guiding — the guide star or the guiding itself; meridian_flip — the planned flip; equipment — anything else in the setup (power, focus, a cable, the mount); fatigue — the observer needed a rest; other — everything else. Absent means the person did not say, which is valid and common.
